caption: Every repository has an Issues tab right next to Pull requests.
A title, a description, and metadata. "It's broken" helps nobody — be specific.
A visual board — Backlog, In Progress, Done — built from your issues and PRs.
Adding an item to a board view is as direct as typing in a row.
